NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Png Optimizer
patches.description: Compresses PNG images without losing quality and strips hidden metadata (DPI, timestamps, text) to make the app smaller. Only rewrites files when the result is actually smaller.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Disables ad SDKs, ruins ad network request URLs, and hides empty ad containers across the app.

patches.name: Remove Analytics
patches.description: Disables tracking and crash-reporting tools, corrupts analytics web links inside the code, and removes background tracking services.

patches.name: Remove Duplicate Graphics
patches.description: Keeps images for only one screen density (like xhdpi) and removes copies for all other densities. Android will automatically scale the kept images, making the app significantly smaller.

options.title: Target density
options.description: Density bucket to keep; duplicates are stripped from every other bucket.

patches.name: Remove Languages
patches.description: Removes translations for languages you don't use. Only keeps the languages you pick. The default English strings are always kept.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Language codes (e.g. en, ru, es) whose resources should not be removed. Add a code to keep more languages, or remove one to also delete it.
